faqs.question: What is WhatsApp automation and how can it help my business?
faqs.answer: WhatsApp automation helps businesses automate customer communication, follow-ups, notifications, and routine tasks.

faqs.question: Can you build AI-powered WhatsApp chatbots?
faqs.answer: Yes. We build AI-powered chatbots that can understand customer queries and provide automated, real-time responses.

faqs.question: Can WhatsApp automation integrate with my existing CRM or website?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can integrate WhatsApp automation with CRMs, websites, APIs, and other business systems.

faqs.question: Can I automate customer notifications and follow-ups on WhatsApp?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can automate order updates, reminders, notifications, follow-ups, and other customer communications.

faqs.question: Is WhatsApp automation suitable for small businesses?
faqs.answer: Yes. WhatsApp automation can help businesses of all sizes save time, improve customer engagement, and handle repetitive communication efficiently.
